title: Tide Forecast Freshness Watch
dataSources: Battery telemetry (`marine:battery`), AIS traffic (`marine:ais`), shore power (`marina:power`), tide forecasts (`tide:table`), export syncs (`marine:export`).
app: Boating and marine telemetry — Victron BMV battery exports, AIS transponder logs, shore-power meter readings, and NOAA tide tables — streamed to Splunk HEC via NMEA exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=marine:export source_name=* source_event_epoch=* export_epoch=*
| eval lag_hours=round((export_epoch-source_event_epoch)/3600,1)
| stats avg(lag_hours) as avg_lag_hours, max(lag_hours) as worst_lag_hours by source_name
| sort - avg_lag_hours
description: Measures tide-data sync lag by data source for marine data exports.
value: Lag tracking shows which data source create the slowest handoffs, syncs, or review loops inside marine data exports.
implementation: Capture the timestamps needed to compute `tide-data sync lag` on `marine:export` events and aggregate them by `source_name`.
visualization: Table of data source with average and worst tide-data sync lag.
grandmaExplanation: It produces how long things take for each data source so you can see where marine data exports slows down.
